# Release Notes Generation

## Overview

Release notes are generated by a custom Python script
(`.github/actions/generate-release-notes/generate_notes.py`), not Release
Drafter. It reads `.github/release-notes-config.yml` for category/label
rules and formatting, then builds notes from the merged PRs between the
previous release of the same channel and the exact commit being released.

## How It Works

### 1. Previous Release Detection

`release.yml` determines the previous release to diff against using tag
patterns, per channel:

| Channel | Pattern | Compares against |
|---|---|---|
| stable | `^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$` | latest stable tag |
| beta | `^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(b\|rc)[0-9]+$` | latest beta/rc tag |
| rc | RC1: latest beta tag; RC2+: previous RC tag | see below |
| nightly | `^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.dev[0-9]+$` | latest nightly tag |

RC releases diff against the latest beta when it's the first RC of a cycle
(`rc1`), or against the previous RC otherwise.

### 2. Commit Range

The generator gets merged PRs between the previous tag and the exact commit
SHA being released (not a moving branch tip), using the GitHub API. If no
previous tag exists for the channel, it falls back to the last 100 commits.

### 3. Categorization

PRs are grouped into sections by label, as configured in
`.github/release-notes-config.yml`:
- ⚠ Breaking Changes (`breaking-change`)
- 🚀 New Providers (`new-provider`)
- 🚀 Features and enhancements (`feature`, `enhancement`, `new-feature`)
- 🐛 Bugfixes (`bugfix`)
- 🧰 Maintenance (`ci`, `documentation`, `maintenance`, `dependencies`)

### 4. Frontend Changes and Contributors

The generator also finds all "⬆️ Update music-assistant-frontend to X.X.X"
PRs merged in the same range, extracts their release notes into a dedicated
"🎨 Frontend Changes" section, and merges/deduplicates `@username` mentions
from both server and frontend PRs into a single "Thanks to our contributors"
section.

## Example Output

```markdown
## ⚠ Breaking Changes
- Major API refactoring (by @contributor1 in #123)

## 🚀 Features and enhancements
- Add new audio processor (by @contributor2 in #124)
- Improve queue management (by @contributor3 in #125)

## 🐛 Bugfixes
- Fix playback issue (by @contributor1 in #126)

## 🎨 Frontend Changes
- Fix player menu position (by @contributor4 in #1175)

## :bow: Thanks to our contributors

Special thanks to the following contributors who helped with this release:

@contributor1, @contributor2, @contributor3, @contributor4
```

## Configuration

`.github/release-notes-config.yml` controls category definitions, titles,
the PR change-line template, and excluded (bot) contributors — see that file
for the current rules.

## Verification Commands

```bash
# Check what will be in the next stable release
git log "$(git tag -l | grep -E '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | sort -V | tail -1)"..stable --oneline

# Check what will be in the next beta release
git log "$(git tag -l | grep -E '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+b[0-9]+$' | sort -V | tail -1)"..dev --oneline

# Check what will be in the next nightly release
git log "$(git tag -l | grep -E '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.dev[0-9]+$' | sort -V | tail -1)"..dev --oneline
```
